items.docs: Search wireless client events for a site with filters for event type, AP, SSID, WLAN, radio band, and time range. Use [Search Org Wireless Client Events](/#operations/searchOrgWirelessClientEvents) to search wireless client events across the organization.

params.name: ap
params.description: Filter results by AP MAC address

params.name: band
params.description: Comma separated list of Radio band (e.g. `24,5`). enum: `24`, `5`, `6`

params.name: device
params.description: Comma separated list of Device type (e.g. `Mac,iPhone`). Case sensitive

params.name: hostname
params.description: Partial / full Client hostname. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `everest*` and `*rest*` match `my-everest-client`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*everest`) are not supported

params.name: ip
params.description: Partial / full Client IP address. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `10.100.10.*` and `*100.10.*` match `10.100.10.54`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*.54`) are not supported

params.name: mac
params.description: Partial / full Client MAC address. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `aabbcc*` and `*bbcc*` match `aabbccddeeff`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*bccddeeff`) are not supported

params.name: model
params.description: Only available for clients running the Marvis Client app, model, e.g. "MBP 15 late 2013", 6, 6s, "8+ GSM"

params.name: os
params.description: Only available for clients running the Marvis Client app, os, e.g. Sierra, Yosemite, Windows 10

params.name: psk_id
params.description: PSK identifier used to filter the results

params.name: psk_name
params.description: Only available for clients using PPSK authentication, the Name of the PSK

params.name: ssid
params.description: Filter results by SSID

params.name: text
params.description: Partial / full MAC address, hostname, username, psk_name or ip. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `everest*` and `*rest*` match `my-everest-client`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*client`) are not supported

params.name: username
params.description: Partial / full username. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `johndoe*` and `*mycorp*` match `johndoe@mycorp.com`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*mycorp.com`) are not supported

params.name: vlan
params.description: Filter results by VLAN ID

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: sort
params.description: On which field the list should be sorted, -prefix represents DESC order

params.name: search_after
params.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving subsequent pages of results. This value is automatically populated by Mist in the `next` URL from the previous response and should not be manually constructed.

items.docs: Search wireless clients connected to a site with filters for client identity, AP, SSID, VLAN, radio band, and time range. Fuzzy matching with `*` is supported on `mac`, `hostname`, `device`, `os`, and `model`, for example `/clients/search?device=Mac*&hostname=jerry`. Use [Search Org Wireless Clients](/#operations/searchOrgWirelessClients) to search wireless clients across the organization.
